items.followUp: What is data sharing over a network?

rubric.why: Identifies the essential purpose of file sharing.
rubric.description: States that file sharing makes files available or accessible.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for expressing that files are made available or accessible to others.

rubric.why: Identifies how or between whom files are shared.
rubric.description: Mentions sharing files over a network or with other computers.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning a network or other computers.

modelAnswer: File sharing is the process of making files available to other computers over a network.
